programme.title: Tridev (1989)
programme.desc: An exiled police officer, a bandit, and a commissioner's son are framed by a smuggler. They unite to teach him a lesson and prove their innocence.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Abandoned as a young child, lonely Vicky finds affection in a teacher and Aarti. When Aarti's uncle sells her, she kills herself to escape assault. Enraged, Vicky becomes an underworld don, seeking revenge on her molesters.

programme.title: Karamdaata
programme.desc: When Sachin Tichkule's payment is held, the ambitious municipal contractor sues. Matters worsen when the new commissioner is his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Dulaara
programme.desc: Innocent Raja, living under his late father's criminal shadow, strives to prove innocence and win back his love who believes him a murderer. Can he prove he's framed?

programme.title: Naqab
programme.desc: Photographer Imran sees a vanishing singer. Questioning his sanity, he's haunted by her appearances, revealing an enigma.

programme.title: Amar Akbar Anthony
programme.desc: A family of five separates due to an incident. Brothers are raised in different religions. Years later, they reunite to avenge those responsible.

programme.title: Blue Mountains
programme.desc: A small-town teen singer wins a reality show but suffers depression after defeat. He must find inner strength to rediscover himself.

programme.title: Souten
programme.desc: Four friends become murder suspects after starting a club where youngsters fight for money.

programme.title: Daata
programme.desc: Kundan loses his father and sister to dowry injustice. Seeking revenge, he commits murder, and his life spirals downwards.

programme.title: Auzaar
programme.desc: Docile Indian cook Ramji arrives in London for work, only to find his employer dead and immigration issues forcing him to marry.

programme.title: Daulat
programme.desc: CID officer Vijay seeks Kavita's missing father, falls for her. Unaware of a criminal sabotaging his family and love life, he tries to woo her.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: Prakash marries a rich businessman's daughter. To gain his father-in-law's approval, he fakes his wife's kidnapping. The plan backfires when real kidnappers intervene.

programme.title: I Proud To Be An Indian
programme.desc: An indefinite flight delay strands 40 passengers, a blessing in disguise as couples of all ages reflect on their relationships.

programme.title: Rishtey
programme.desc: Gambler Jai works for a don, unaware his skills yield military secrets. Inspector Vijay goes undercover, but he and Jai are look-alikes, causing confusion.

programme.title: Abhimaan
programme.desc: Singer Subir encourages his wife Uma's career. When her popularity surpasses his, his pride is wounded, threatening their marriage.

programme.title: Bemisal
programme.desc: "Bemisal" is the story of noble orphan Sudhir, who sacrifices everything, including love, profession, and reputation, to save his foster family.

programme.title: Toh Baat Pakki
programme.desc: An aspiring actress becomes a bar dancer when her acting career fails. A man offers to help her. Will her dream of making it big in Mumbai ever come true?

programme.title: Bumper Draw
programme.desc: Spanish Laura travels to India seeking missing boyfriend Robert. Her quest leads to Paharganj's shady lanes, where she learns his disappearance is linked to a murder.

programme.title: Gone Kesh
programme.desc: The film follows teenage dancer Enakshi, who is diagnosed with alopecia, causing rapid hair loss.

programme.title: Aakhri Badla
programme.desc: A secret agent, his faithful sidekick, and a Japanese karate master combine their skills to take down an elusive international smuggling gang after their getaway ship carrying smuggled gold sinks in a cyclone.

programme.title: Jaalsaaz
programme.desc: Wealthy Ranjit Rai is murdered. Police blame his mistress Radha. Her lover Rakesh tries to bail her, unaware Radha is a pawn in a deadly conspiracy.

programme.title: Katha
programme.desc: Shy, simple tailor Jatin struggles to interact with girls due to lack of confidence.

programme.title: Kya Kehna
programme.desc: A young college girl faces hardships after becoming a single mother.

programme.title: Kaun Sachcha Kaun Jhootha
programme.desc: Ajay lives happily with family & girlfriend, gets a high-end job. Framed for assaulting three college girls, he goes to prison, destroying his personal life.

programme.title: Shiva
programme.desc: An ailing woman's letters to her busy son in Mumbai go unanswered. Her grandkids discover them and secretly journey to Goa to meet her.

programme.title: Dream Girl (1977)
programme.desc: Sapna, using aliases, steals for orphans. She meets wealthy bachelor, poses as a princess, lives in his bungalow. Her past catches up when recognized as prostitute Champabai.

programme.title: Bluff Master
programme.desc: Womaniser Mandar, obsessed with sex, falls for Tripti. He tries to change for her, but struggles to hide his notorious past, inviting trouble.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: Kailash's scientist uncle develops energy-saving formula. Jeevan's boss, Mehta, covets it, forcing Jeevan to retrieve blueprints, endangering Kailash and his love.

programme.title: Ghulam-E-Mustafa
programme.desc: An NRI student, a photographer, his friend, and a bank employee witness Kashmir's true spirit traveling across the region.

programme.title: Bewaffa Se Waffa
programme.desc: After losing his wife in an accident, Anand gives his child to a widow who lost her baby. Anand is caught in a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Avtaar
programme.desc: Retired mechanic Avtaar and his wife are swindled out of their home by sons. Avtaar decides to rebuild a successful business with his wife and loyal servant Sewak's support.

programme.title: Abhimaan
programme.desc: Singer Subir encourages his wife Uma's career. When her popularity surpasses his, his pride is wounded, threatening their marriage.

programme.title: Gupt The Hidden Truth
programme.desc: Sahil Sinha loves Isha but his father insists on an arranged marriage. After an argument, Jaisingh dies. Sahil is blamed, jailed, and escapes to find the real killer.

programme.title: Fun2shh... Dudes In The 10th Century
programme.desc: Four absurdly infatuated friends Gopal, Lucky, Madhav, and Laxman all fall for the same girl, leading to a hilarious race to win her heart.

programme.title: Kaagaz Ke Fools
programme.desc: Crooked encounter specialist Sameer, with childhood friend Jagga, is fearless. His girlfriend Renu tries to change him. Will Sameer mend his ways for love or remain corrupt?

programme.title: Balwinder Singh Famous Ho Gaya
programme.desc: Two struggling Punjabi singers, both named Balwinder Singh, move to Mumbai to try films, fall for the same girl, and share a room.

programme.title: Falak (the Sky)
programme.desc: Watchman Ramnath is killed trying to stop corrupt bosses. Years later, his sons vow revenge on those responsible for his murder.

programme.title: Tathastu... So Be It
programme.desc: A complicated love triangle explores societal expectations versus personal happiness and free will, focusing on an unhappily married man who wants to keep his girlfriend without divorcing.

programme.title: Global Baba
programme.desc: Betrayed by a politician, a criminal becomes a spiritual guru, gaining followers & political power through manipulation.

programme.title: Battalion 609
programme.desc: An Indian army battalion challenges the Pakistani army to a cricket match to reclaim disputed land.

programme.title: Deadline: Sirf 24 Ghante
programme.desc: Dr. Viren's daughter is kidnapped for ransom. Despite paying, the kidnappers vanish with both money and Anishka, leaving him in distress.

programme.title: Wedding Anniversary
programme.desc: A desperate, poor man seizes a hospital with a gun, demanding staff focus on his child's operation, turning it into a hostage and media circus.

programme.title: Chot Aj Isko, Kal Tereko
programme.desc: Elderly noble Ambaprasad, realizing relatives only care for his wealth, discards it and leaves home in search of happiness.

programme.title: Prem Geet
programme.desc: Richest man Vikrant Raina's daughter is kidnapped. The kidnapper demands he complete deadly tasks to settle an old score, not money.

programme.title: Vishwanath
programme.desc: Righteous public prosecutor Vishwanath is framed and imprisoned. Upon release, he seeks revenge, even if it means breaking the laws he once defended.

programme.title: Bhanwar
programme.desc: Roopa writes love letters to herself to fake a love life. Challenged, she uses stranger Anoop to back her lie. While pretending, Anoop falls for her.

programme.title: Charitra Heen
programme.desc: A middle-class man marries a millionaire's daughter despite family opposition. Marital differences arise, and he finds solace with another woman.

programme.title: Kaalia
programme.desc: A religious joint family worships its deity. The eldest son, initially unconcerned with beliefs, experiences incidents that lead him to believe in God.

programme.title: Trishul
programme.desc: Vijay Kumar, illegitimate son of construction baron Raj Kumar Gupta, seeks revenge after his mother's death. He aims to destroy the Gupta family's business and connections.

programme.title: Deewaar
programme.desc: Brothers Vijay and Ravi Verma, sons of a disgraced unionist, follow different paths: Vijay, a smuggler; Ravi, a cop hunting him. Raised by their poor single mother in Bombay, they face hardships.

programme.title: Johny Mera Naam
programme.desc: Separated by destiny, brothers Mohan and Sohan grow up fatherless. Mohan seeks to kill their father's murderer. Sohan becomes a cop, goes undercover as smuggler Johny, making life-changing discoveries.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan

programme.title: Jurassic Hunt
programme.desc: In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, Female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & must work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures and mercenaries hired to finish them off. This battle's about to become primitive.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Riders Of Justice
programme.desc: Markus goes home to his teenage daughter, Mathilde, when his wife dies in a train crash. All appears to be a tragic accident until a mathematics geek, who was also a fellow passenger on the train, and his two colleagues show up.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: Deep in the ice of the antarctic, a team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

To win the competition, the manipulative "good boss" unknowingly starts an explosive chain reaction with wild consequences.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.desc: A skate documentary following a 10-day tour across Thailand, featuring demos and premieres in several cities, capturing the energy of local skate scenes and the passion of skaters coming together to celebrate.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: En Route America
programme.desc: A road trip across the West Coast, following skiers as they explore iconic mountains and chase winter conditions across the United States.

programme.title: En Route Departure
programme.desc: Follow Pep Fujas, Blake Nyman, Anthony Boronowski, Dylan Hood, Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and more as they chase storms from a Top Secret Military Mountain Warfare Facility, to the Italian Alps.

programme.title: Falling Angels
programme.desc: Three female BASE jumpers trek deep into the Venezuelan jungle to attempt a historic jump from the world’s highest waterfall, facing extreme terrain, technical challenges, and one of the most dangerous exits in the sport.

programme.title: Gunnie Season
programme.desc: An extreme skiing film featuring some of the world’s top professional skiers pushing their limits on snow and steep terrain.

programme.title: Peace And Left
programme.desc: A surf series following Hugues Oyarzabal, capturing spectacular first-person barrel footage at iconic spots around the globe, offering a rare inside view of high-performance surfing.

This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.
